steps.title: Welcome
steps.instruction: This is a road-and-carrier settlement game. Build Woodcutter, Forester, Sawmill and Quarry, connect them to Headquarters by roads, then store 10 planks and 10 stone.

steps.title: Move the map
steps.instruction: Pan with WASD or right-drag, and zoom with +/- or the mouse wheel.

steps.title: Inspect Headquarters
steps.instruction: Click your Headquarters (gold building at the center) to see details in the inspector panel.

steps.title: Start time
steps.instruction: Press Play or Space to run the simulation. Watch the tick counter increase, then pause when ready.

steps.title: Road mode
steps.instruction: Click Road (or press R). Click a hex on your road network, then click a destination to extend roads toward forest and rock.

steps.title: Build Woodcutter
steps.instruction: Select Woodcutter, move over forest near a road, and click a valid hex to place a construction site.

steps.title: Build Forester
steps.instruction: Foresters renew forest. Place a Forester Camp on forest terrain connected by roads.

steps.title: Build Sawmill
steps.instruction: Sawmills turn timber into planks. Place a Sawmill on grass with road access.

steps.title: Build Quarry
steps.instruction: Quarries produce stone from rock. Place a Quarry on quarryable terrain near roads.

steps.title: Watch the economy
steps.instruction: Press Play and watch carriers deliver materials. Check the inspector and warnings if a building is waiting.

steps.title: Objective complete
steps.instruction: When all four buildings are built, connected, and you store 10 planks and 10 stone, you win!
